answer: A airfield firefighter tenure with drill attendance record works as the gate: drills attended at one airfield for years. Each of 141 aliases needs its own drill records, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The ferrous test is the price tag: 141 fakes mean 141 payments. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The glacier signal is visible to every grader, and the quartz ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
